description: Client-facing statistics dashboard, Stripe billing integration with usage metering, and client settings/threshold configuration UI. This covers the business-facing features: aggregate stats showing the system is working (flags over time, response times, false-positive rates), billing tied to conversation volume, and the self-service configuration for thresholds.
steps: Create src/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx (overview/stats dashboard): Client-facing statistics page showing aggregate metrics. Cards for: total conversations monitored (period), flags raised (by category), average response time (flag to action), false positive rate trend, crisis routes triggered, conversations blocked. Charts: flags over time (line chart, last 30 days), category breakdown (pie/donut chart), response time trend. Use recharts or a lightweight charting library compatible with shadcn/ui.

Create src/app/api/v1/stats/route.ts: API endpoint returning aggregate statistics for the authenticated client. Metrics: conversation_count, turn_count, flag_count (by category and severity), action_count (by type), average_response_time_ms, false_positive_rate, crisis_route_count. Supports date range filtering. All queries are tenant-isolated.

Create src/app/(dashboard)/settings/page.tsx: Client settings page with tabs for: General (company name, webhook URL for action notifications), Thresholds (per-category threshold configuration with sliders showing current values vs system minimums, clear indication that crisis routing thresholds cannot be lowered below system floor), Team (invite/manage team members with roles), API Keys (list/create/revoke).

Create src/app/api/v1/settings/thresholds/route.ts: GET/PUT endpoint for threshold configuration. PUT validates that no threshold is set below system minimum (enforced server-side, not just UI). Returns the effective threshold configuration including which are at system minimum vs client-configured.

Create src/lib/billing/stripe.ts: Stripe integration module. Functions: createCustomer (on client signup), createSubscription (with tiered pricing: Starter $199/mo up to 10K conversations, Growth $499/mo up to 50K, Enterprise $999/mo up to 250K), reportUsage (meter conversation/turn counts), getUsage (current period usage), handleWebhook (subscription changes, payment failures). Use Stripe's usage-based billing with metered billing items.
Create src/app/api/v1/billing/webhook/route.ts: Stripe webhook handler for subscription events (created, updated, canceled, payment_failed). Updates client record with current plan and status.

Create src/app/(dashboard)/billing/page.tsx: Billing page showing current plan, usage this period (conversations and turns with visual meter toward limit), next invoice estimate, plan upgrade/downgrade options, payment method management (Stripe Customer Portal link).
Create src/app/api/v1/billing/route.ts: GET current billing status, POST create/update subscription, GET /usage for current period metering.

Create src/lib/billing/usage-tracker.ts: Usage tracking that increments conversation and turn counts per client per billing period. Called from the ingestion pipeline. Includes overage detection and alerting (when client approaches plan limit).

Write tests: tests/lib/billing/stripe.test.ts (subscription creation, usage reporting, plan limits, webhook handling with mocked Stripe API), tests/api/stats.test.ts (correct aggregation, tenant isolation of stats, date range filtering), tests/api/settings.test.ts (threshold update respects system minimums, RBAC enforcement - only ADMIN can change thresholds).
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck passes with zero errors
npm test passes all billing, stats, and settings tests
Stats API returns correct aggregated data isolated per tenant
Threshold configuration UI and API enforce system minimum floors
Stripe webhook handler correctly processes subscription lifecycle events
Usage tracking increments correctly and detects plan limit approach
Billing page shows current usage relative to plan limit
